documents.title: Supporting evidence
documents.text:
I have worked in a care home in Leeds for three years since October 2023 providing daily care and support to residents. I knock on the door before entering, explain what I will do before personal hygiene and always close the curtains to protect dignity. I respect each person's culture and religion and ask how they want to be addressed and treated, including what they want to eat and whether they prefer to be helped by a woman.

One night I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and told the nurse on duty immediately. I have moving and handling training and use the hoist. We always work in pairs. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents.

Before each shift I read each resident's care plan and follow it. At the end of the shift I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet. We as the whole team moved dinner earlier. I made cards with photos of food so each person can point to what they want. I did night shifts for two years, not three, and in the last year I moved to days.

Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,

I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.

I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023. I read each resident's care plan before the shift and follow it. I have moving and handling training and use the hoist.

I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents. I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet at the end of the shift. I knock on the door before entering as part of dignity.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely, Ana
